title: atom
description: The unit of matter: a nucleus of protons and neutrons with a surrounding electron structure. The substrate floor of the life tree — what bonds into the molecules that assemble into cells that integrate into organisms. (The corpus's chemistry, the bulk of which is the degenerate shadow; here it is the matter substrate from which life is generated, not a separate discipline.)

nucleus.description: protons (and neutrons) fixing the element's identity

electrons.description: the electron structure that governs bonding and ionization
